confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Florence pricing, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderate-confidence. Accommodation is least certain because July rates vary widely by room, neighbourhood and week; it assumes all-in rates including city tax. Cocktail and wine anchors follow the local price relationship to beer because direct knowledge of them is weaker. The FX value comes from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page; the F11.1 table itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Restaurant, cafe and bar anchors are benchmarked to general Italian city-centre price levels, with central Rome and Bologna as reference points. Accommodation anchors reflect July peak-season demand in Florence's historic centre, estimated from general knowledge rather than a named comparable city.
